english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for saying that B happens during the time of A.
Use this when one event happens or continues during the time of another event.

examples.english: While I’m at work, help me look after the kid.
examples.traditional: 我返工嗰陣，你幫我睇住個仔。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 faan1 gung1 go2 zan6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 tai2 zyu6 go3 zai2

examples.english: Mum had just finished cooking as I got home.
examples.traditional: 我返到屋企嗰陣，阿媽啱啱煮好飯。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 go2 zan6 aa3 maa1 ngaam1 ngaam1 zyu2 hou2 faan6
